mapper.select: select i.id, i.user_id, i.content, i.comments, su.nick_name, su.avatar, sr.role_name from invitation i left join sys_user su on i.user_id=su.user_id left join sys_user_role sur on su.user_id=sur.user_id left join sys_role sr on sur.role_id=sr.role_id where i.is_deleted=0 order by i.create_time desc
